events.title: COFA Annual FREE Kids' Paper Target Turkey Shoot and Hands-on Outdoor Activities
events.time: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Mountain Standard Time; arrive by 12:15 PM for competitive target shooting
events.location: Colorado Adventure Point, 10455 W 6th Ave, Suite 150, Lakewood, CO 80215
events.cost: $0 registration and activities; $0 total for two adults and three children if admitted. Food and beverages optional, extra.
events.age: BB-gun paper-target competition ages 8–15; younger children may try noncompetition BB target shooting only if safely able to handle a BB gun; climbing, archery, leather craft and outdoor education for children. Parents/guardians attend. Open registration, but COFA is a faith-based private ministry and expressly makes participation subject to agreement with its Statement of Faith and Code of Conduct; it may restrict admission.
events.description: One-day no-charge specialized Colorado Adventure Point experience combines organizer-supplied BB paper-target competition (no live animals), climbing wall, archery, leather crafts and outdoor education. Participants register at https://cofausa.org/civicrm/event/register/?id=393&reset=1. Official page states date, hours, ages, free price and faith-based eligibility restriction; signup page confirms free group registration. Specific registration deadline and remaining capacity not published. This is for 2026 Colorado residents, not the household's 2027–28 planned stay.
